Preserve the original garment design, uniform type, fabric, colors, headgear, glasses, decorations, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, action, framing, lighting, background and painterly color treatment. RETAILOR the collar/neck opening and shoulder fit to the mascot rather than copying a narrow human neck opening. Keep all existing garment design details and insignia; do not invent new hats, uniforms, medals or symbols. Collar and anatomy: use a compact rounded mascot head seated close to broad shoulders, with a very short, wide neck transition. No tall cylindrical/giraffe neck, no long tapered yellow stalk above the clothing. The entire neck base must fit INSIDE a correctly sized collar opening. The head silhouette is nearly round or a SHORT egg shape. Its chin rests immediately above the garment collar, without copying the original human neck length. Preserve the shoulder position and crop by broadening the fitted garment; do not fill that space with a tall yellow column.

Do not turn a closed military collar into a deep V-neck or unbuttoned shirt. Preserve open lapels/shirt collars only where the original is actually open.

No comparison board, new text, label, watermark or extra figure.

Original brown/khaki OPEN jacket with red/gold collar tabs, pale khaki shirt, muted olive tie and original brass details. Retain the exact original visible hair, headgear and accessories. Any moustache stays ABOVE the small horizontal mouth. Use a nearly round head seated directly above the properly fitted collar with broad shoulders, no separate tall yellow neck, no cream neck bib, no human nose or ears. Preserve original garment opening/closure, pose, lighting and crop.
